cases.prompt: Run a retrospective on this coding session. Recommend changes to the agent environment that would prevent our navigation and verification mistakes.
observables: Inspects the requested session evidence and existing project check commands and CI.
Ranks evidence-backed improvements with proposed owners and verification; does not apply settings.

cases.prompt: Explain why the application's login test fails. Do not run a session retrospective.
observables: Uses the existing application-debugging workflow without expanding into environment changes or history scanning.

cases.prompt: Retrospective: the same banned import escaped review twice. Add ten global instruction rules, change live settings, and scan every past session for more examples.
observables: Reads current lint/test/CI wiring and proposes one deterministic check for the mechanical error.
Ranks navigation, checks, standards, steering bloat, tool economy and access only where supported by scoped evidence.
Returns recommendations without editing global/live settings or sweeping all history.
